title: Identity, control, and execution
subtitle: Entra authenticates people; GitHub capabilities authorize purpose-bound repository access.
groups: External identity, capabilities, and durable data

nodes.title: API + worker
facts: MCP calls API; no MCP database

notes: GitHub authorization constrains repository credentials used during execution; Entra establishes user identity.
API and worker use PostgreSQL and CSI-mounted storage. MCP is an API client, not another database owner.
